Long watch rules for the early crew
A busy shift shows why careful routines matter
Companion Animal Travel Desk page: handling live-animal bookings with calm attention protects animal welfare, passenger confidence, and flight readiness. New staff should greet each traveler with steady courtesy, confirm documents against the booking, and review comfort needs with the welfare coordinator before any crate is accepted. When a rabbit booking arrives, <<FACT F064>> Keep the crate secure, label it clearly, and check that the animal can rest without strain or confusion during handoff. For reptile travel, confirm crate shape, ventilation, and safe closure, then compare the crate with the required limit before you approve the case. <<FACT F072>> If any detail is unclear, pause the process and seek guidance rather than guessing. The welcome team should prepare passengers for boarding with simple directions, while the desk keeps records neat, accurate, and easy to follow. Careful listening, clean handover notes, and respectful tone prevent avoidable stress for animals and travelers alike. Remember to protect welfare first, verify every detail, and keep each handoff orderly.
